kkTitel.abgefragt_wird_was_du_eingetragen: You get quizzed on what you wrote.

kkLede.kurze_karten_aus_deinem_berichtsheft: Short cards from your report book and from what your training framework still lacks. What you didn’t know comes back before you forget it.

kkKastenCap.leer_lade_den_beispielstapel_um: Empty. Load the sample deck to try it out.

kkQuellenU.in_dieser_reihenfolge_die_ki: In this order. The AI doesn’t make up the topic, it is given one.

kkQ1P.was_du_eingetragen_hast_betrieb: What you wrote down, at work and at vocational school. That is revision.

kkQ2P.lernziele_deines_berufs_zu_denen: Learning goals of your occupation that your report book doesn’t mention yet. That is catching up, and exactly that hurts in the exam.

kkQ3P.fuer_faecher_die_in_keinem: For subjects that aren’t in any training framework: paste text or take a photo of your notebook page.

kkA1T.es_merkt_sich_was_du: It remembers what you didn’t know

kkA1P.eine_falsche_karte_rutscht_zurueck: A wrong card slides back into the first box and comes back tomorrow. A right one moves further back until it only comes up once a month.

kkA2T.du_musst_nichts_fragen: You don’t have to ask anything

kkA2P.kein_eingabefeld_fuer_fragen_keine: No field for questions, no prompts. You open the box and today’s stack is already there.

kkA3T.jede_karte_sagt_woher_sie: Every card says where it comes from

kkA3P.unter_jeder_antwort_steht_die: Below every answer is its source: your week in the report book, the learning goal or your material. If something is wrong, you report the card with one tap.

kkVorschauP.der_kasten_selbst_funktioniert_schon: The box itself already works: boxes, intervals and quizzes run on your device. Cards from your report book, the training framework and your own material will be built by an AI later. Until the Training Pass launches, the preview is free. After that the flashcard box is part of the Pass, and it says so right now.

kkLeeren.kasten_auf_diesem_geraet_leeren: Empty the box on this device

kkStoff.zum_beispiel_deine_mitschrift_aus: For example your notes from civics class
